create_assistant_model: create an Assistant model instance with a params dict containing encoder, use_gpu, and share_embeddings keys
build_assistant_forward_training: build the assistant forward pass in training mode to compute token, action, and action_attr losses
test_assistant_forward_generation: test the assistant forward pass with BEAMSEARCH mode to generate text via beam search decoding
test_assistant_forward_retrieval: test the assistant forward pass in retrieval evaluation mode to score candidate responses
review_assistant_forward_inference: review the assistant forward pass in inference mode to return outputs with loss_sum and num_tokens
